reference_reproduction.limits: Synthetic scalar ordering and ACC-only vector witnesses; no joint physically realized trajectory, no raw replay, population SD for toy only; reported raw ddof unknown. No formal or physical gate credit.

W1.note: (N-1)/duration reproduces both reported rates bit-exactly. Effective rate exceeds requested 100 Hz by ~0.15 Hz; Android sensors_overview documents that requested rate != measured rate.

W2.interpretation: Reported value is consistent with abs(mean(mag)-g0) evaluated on the rounded mean (96 ULP apart), matching AXIOM 04_REFERENCE. It does NOT establish mean(abs(norm-g0)); that requires raw norms.

W3.construction: two-point distribution {m-s, m+s} matches reported mag_mean and population-SD mag_stdev exactly
W3.claim: |mean-g0| is only a lower bound of mean|norm-g0| (Jensen). On an aggregate-consistent distribution the gap is strictly positive.

W4.claim: The ~0.026 m/s^2 residual conflates sensor bias, scale error and local gravity deviation; conventional g0 was not an independently measured local value in R21.

W5.note: Reported standard_deviation_definition is UNKNOWN. Population vs sample (n-1) SD differ by this factor for n=7014 (~71 ppm); raw or definition needed to decide.

W6.claim: Magnitude summaries are SO(3)-invariant: any tilt/yaw of the device leaves ACC and GYRO magnitudes unchanged. Device orientation is unidentifiable from norms alone; BodyTwin body-pose inference from phone-on-table magnitudes is not supported.

W7.construction_B: variation split equally on X and Y, zero on Z
W7.claim: Two datasets with identical magnitude mean/SD can have entirely different axis covariance (diag(0,0,v) vs diag(v/2,v/2,0)); norm SD does not constrain axis covariance.

W8.claim: A constant gyro bias vector and a constant true rotation component are observationally equivalent under this aggregate. Note gyro magnitude mean is ~27x Earth rate and ~0.11 deg/s, so scale/bias dominates Earth-rate comparison; an independent angle reference is required.

W9.claim: Mean and SD are invariant under reordering while lag-1 autocorrelation differs sharply; no temporal (drift/whiteness) claim is identifiable from the reported aggregates.

W10.claim: 70 of 7000 events removed in clusters of <=4 consecutive events produce max gap of exactly 5x median dt; the strict > 5x-median rule flags nothing. Zero flagged gaps is NOT proof of zero packet loss; matches the R21 gaps_gt_5x_median = 0 interpretation limit.

W11.claim: 12 numbers summarize 14,018 sensor events (14,020 NDJSON lines minus 2 non-sensor); over 99.9 percent of event-level information is absent from the aggregate.

W12.claim: AXIOM 04_REFERENCE.js reproduces bit-exactly as independent derived arithmetic here, but it is explicitly synthetic + aggregate-derived; it is NOT an independent raw replay and carries no formal gate credit (per 05_RESULTS scope field).

E2.lesson: A fixed 1e-12 absolute tolerance accepts a 1e-13-scale tampering. Verification tolerances must be ULP-scaled, e.g. Math.abs(diff) <= 8 * Number.EPSILON * Math.max(Math.abs(a), Math.abs(b)). Honest limitation of the 04_REFERENCE tolerance design.

E3.claim: The member hash comparator rejects a single-hex-digit manifest tamper (REJECT) and accepts the genuine hash (ACCEPT).

error_case_observations.E2: E2 EMPIRICAL DEVIATION from its own intended lesson: at value magnitude ~100.15 Hz, the 1e-13 RELATIVE perturbation is ~1.002e-11 ABSOLUTE, which EXCEEDS the fixed 1e-12 tolerance, so the case was FLAGGED, not MISSED. The sub-tolerance blind spot of a fixed absolute tolerance exists at this magnitude only for relative faults below ~1e-14 (about 0.7 ULP). The shipped witness file is hash-frozen and stays unmodified; this honest deviation is recorded here. The N21 recommendation (ULP-scaled tolerance) stands regardless, because a fixed absolute tolerance scales incorrectly across magnitudes.

falsifiers.F1: Any future 100 Hz sampling claim falsified if (N-1)/duration on reported n/duration deviates beyond ULP-scaled tolerance (W1).
falsifiers.F2: Any gravity-residual claim labeled mean(abs(norm-g0)) falsified by W2/W3 identity analysis unless raw norms are supplied.
falsifiers.F3: Any orientation/pose claim from magnitude-only data falsified by SO(3)-invariance (W6) and axis-covariance invisibility (W7).
falsifiers.F4: Any drift/whiteness/temporal claim from aggregates falsified by ordering-invariance (W9) and bias/rotation ambiguity (W8).
falsifiers.F5: Any zero-packet-loss claim from gaps_gt_5x_median=0 falsified by W10 construction.
